Interface VirtualServerSocket

All Superinterfaces:
VirtualServer
All Known Implementing Classes:
SocketServerHandler
public interface VirtualServerSocket extends VirtualServer
Socket-specific marker interface for VirtualServer.

Unlike VirtualServerRmi, the Socket transport requires no additional methods or throws refinements: commands are simply serialised to JSON and written to the socket's output stream. This interface exists purely to mirror the *Rmi / *Socket naming symmetry and to give the Socket implementation (SocketServerHandler) an explicit, transport-specific type.
